title: Concept: Dynamic expression evaluation in java — review required
description: In java, a script engine or SpEL parser evaluates a runtime string. Expression languages expose class resolution and method invocation, so a payload that reaches eval() runs inside the JVM with the service account’s access. The parser is the dangerous sink even when the current call site looks harmless.
applicability: java services that template rules, filters, or formulas at runtime.
risk: Remote code execution inside the JVM; HIGH severity.
